description_en: Schedules simulated system events for one or more Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances. Simulated system events act as event drills that do not actually execute the events or affect the ECS instances
description_zh: 为一台或多台ECS实例预约模拟系统事件。模拟系统事件相当于事件演习，不会真正执行事件，也不会对ECS实例产生影响
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-simulated-system-events --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --event-type SystemMaintenance.Reboot --instance-id '["i-bp1gtjxuuvwj17zr****"]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSimulatedSystemEvents

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the system event. Valid values: 

SystemMaintenance.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to system maintenance.
SystemFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to a system error.
InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance error.
SystemMaintenance.Stop: The instance is stopped due to system maintenance.
SystemMaintenance.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to system maintenance.
SystemFailure.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to a system error.
SystemFailure.Stop: The instance is stopped due to a system error.
InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance error
parameters.help_zh:
系统事件的类型。取值范围： 

SystemMaintenance.Reboot：因系统维护实例重启。
SystemFailure.Reboot：因系统错误实例重启。
InstanceFailure.Reboot：因实例错误实例重启。
SystemMaintenance.Stop：因系统维护实例停止。
SystemMaintenance.Redeploy：因系统维护实例重新部署。
SystemFailure.Redeploy：因系统错误实例重新部署。
SystemFailure.Stop：因系统错误实例重新停止。
InstanceFailure.Reboot：因实例错误实例重启
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled start time of the event. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

When the TriggerRealOps parameter is set to false, you must specify the NotBefore parameter
parameters.help_zh:
事件计划执行的开始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

当`TriggerRealOps`参数为`false` 时，必须指定`NotBefore` 参数
parameters.name: not_before

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECS instances. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: ECS实例ID列表信息。可输入最多100个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to trigger actual O&M operations. Valid values:
- true: Triggers actual O&M operations. The system actually stops or releases the instance. Proceed with caution during testing, or select an instance that does not run business workloads for testing. The O&M event is generated approximately 1 minute after the API call succeeds.
- false: Simulates only event notifications without affecting the actual lifecycle of the instance. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否触发真实运维操作。取值范围：
- true：触发真实运维，系统将真实执行实例的停机或释放操作，需要谨慎测试，或选择无业务的实例进行测试。运维事件会在API调用成功约1分钟后产生。
- false（默认值）：仅模拟事件通知，不影响实例实际生命周期
parameters.name: trigger_real_ops
